definitions.explanation: a phone setting that disables all wireless communication features, originally designed for use during flights

examples.japanese: {離陸|りりく}{前|まえ}に{機内|きない}モードにしてください。
examples.english: Please switch to airplane mode before takeoff.

examples.japanese: {機内|きない}モードでも{Wi-Fi|わいふぁい}は{使|つか}える。
examples.english: You can still use Wi-Fi even in airplane mode.

examples.japanese: {バッテリー|ばってりー}を{節約|せつやく}するために{機内|きない}モードにした。
examples.english: I turned on airplane mode to save battery.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
- {機内|きない} (inside an aircraft, on board)
- モード (mode)

ALTERNATIVE NAME:
フライトモード (flight mode) is also used.

USAGE:
- {機内|きない}モードにする (to turn on airplane mode)
- {機内|きない}モードを{解除|かいじょ}する (to turn off airplane mode)
- {機内|きない}モードに{切|き}り{替|か}える (to switch to airplane mode)

CONTEXT:
While originally required during flights, many people also use it to save battery or avoid distractions.
